settings.fault: brazen's table has no provider row `gone` — every dispatch through it dies with `unknown provider`; pick a live row, or add the row in the brazen config editor
settings.help: the brazen provider row this role dispatches through
settings.name: provider

settings.help: the wire id this role dispatches on — with the row beside it, the whole of the binding (nothing declares it elsewhere; an id that does not exist is caught at the first live call)
settings.name: model

settings.help: the tool names this role may call (litany's vocabulary, not yog's); yog grants `message` and `dispatch` at creation
settings.name: tools

frames.text:
roles:
  worker:
    provider: gone
    model: m-1
    tools: [bash]

settings.help: how long a changed workspace coalesces before it re-derives — lower re-renders sooner under a storm, 0 turns coalescing off
settings.name: debounce_ms

settings.help: the cheap sweep: enumerations, watch reconcile and liveness re-probes, and the window's idle wake-up floor — the beat most of yog's freshness rides on
settings.name: cheap_sweep_ms

settings.help: the full sweep: re-derive everything, the backstop that bounds staleness when a filesystem event is lost
settings.name: full_sweep_ms

frames.text:
# yog's clock: watcher-cycle periods, in milliseconds.
# Delete this file to restore the defaults below.
cadence:
  watcher:
    debounce_ms: 100
    cheap_sweep_ms: 2000
    full_sweep_ms: 15000
